_leeme: Piezas de la interfaz pedidas a ForgeGUI (generation_gui). Estado: 'listo' = generada (artifact_ref sirve para revisarla o subirla a Roblox con artifact_publish); 'sin_creditos' = falló por falta de créditos y hay que volver a pedirla con el mismo prompt. Los botones de color usan de referencia el BotonVerde. Destino en el juego: GameConfig.Gui y GameConfig.Iconos.

BotonVerde.prompt: Blank Roblox game UI button, NO text, NO icon, NO letters. Wide rounded rectangle (about 3:1), chunky cartoon style like popular Roblox simulator games: bright lime-green vertical gradient (#8CFF5A top to #1FA33A bottom), thick dark navy outline (#1B1F3B) about 6% of the height, glossy white highlight strip across the top third, darker inner bevel at the bottom edge, soft drop shadow under it. Flat even edges so it can be 9-slice scaled. Centered on a fully transparent background, nothing else.
